Definition: from G773 and G746; an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor:--chief of Asia.
BiblicalUsage: The chiefs of Asia were the wealthy men who sponsored the games and festivals in the province, and some of them were Paul's friends. When the riot broke out in Ephesus they sent him a message, begging him not to go into the theatre.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can put friends in unexpected places, and these officials risked their standing to keep Paul safe.
